result.official_quote: It is unlawful for an owner of residential rental property or the owner’s agent to charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household. Any provision of an existing rental agreement or lease that violates the provisions of this chapter shall be null, void, and unenforceable.
result.note: Added § 13.78.018 because the card's rule that contrary lease terms are unenforceable comes from that section, and added the enacting ordinance number from the code's history notes.
